title: Corwin Valley Gas Company
summary: A natural gas local distribution company (two city gates, fourteen district regulator stations, two low-pressure cast-iron districts, PipeView SCADA with an integrator remote-access path) under a TSA pipeline security directive, and a tabletop exercise generated from its simulated plans: an unauthorized SCADA session drives a low-pressure district toward overpressure while the screens show normal pressure.
notice: Exercise material — for training use. Corwin Valley Gas Company, the City of Corwin, Lake Haven County, their people, procedures, numbers, addresses and identifiers are simulated; the public sources consulted for realism are listed in reference/gas-distribution/SOURCES.md.

scenarios.summary: On a cold January evening, odor and high-flame calls come in from downtown Corwin while SCADA shows RS-21 and RS-22 at normal outlet pressure; a district recorder and a technician's field gauge disagree, an integrator account is found writing setpoints to the electronic pilot controllers, and the company must decide whether to isolate OT, run stations locally and shut in Pressure District 7.
scenarios.userPrompt: A January weekday at Corwin Valley Gas Company, 16:50, outdoor temperature 14 °F. The call center logs three high-flame and pilot-outage calls from downtown Corwin in Pressure District 7 within 25 minutes, while the PipeView Low Pressure screen shows RS-21 and RS-22 outlets steady at 10 in. w.c. District recorder PR-7B reads 15 in. w.c. and climbing, but PR-7A shows communication loss. The shift controller calls Gas Control Manager Theresa Novak; M&R Supervisor Raymond Oyelowo sends a technician to RS-22, whose field gauge reads 1.1 psig at the outlet. The PipeView audit trail shows PC-21 and PC-22 setpoints written to 1.8 psig at 16:22 from CVG-ENG01 by the integrator account halden-support, through the OT jump host CVG-OT-JMP01, during a session no one at Halden Automation will claim; the CIRP-5 setpoint-change page never reached the Gas Control Manager, and the outlet transmitter values on the RTUs appear frozen. A red herring: a construction crew near Front Street worked on a main that afternoon (CP-17 sensing-line question). Corwin Fire reports a basement fire on Canal Street and Riverside Manor nursing home reports a stove flare-up. Players must decide whether to order isolation levels I-1 to I-4 under CVG-CIRP-2026, switch RS-21 and RS-22 to mechanical pilots, close Valve 21 and Valve 22 and shut in Pressure District 7 (5,120 customers, two nursing homes, 14 °F night) per CVG-EP-2026 Section 6, notify the Lake Haven County 911 Center, the National Response Center within an hour of confirmed discovery, the Pennsylvania PUC, CISA within 72 hours and TSA, preserve CVG-ENG01 and the jump host with memory images, staff manual operation at every station with eleven M&R technicians, and tell the public through the PIO while Channel 16 and the Corwin Courier report explosions that have not happened.
constraints: Every email address of the company and its units uses the exercise domain corwinvalleygas.example; outside parties use fictional domains and fictional outlet names (Channel 16, the Corwin Courier); never a real agency, company or newspaper domain.

Player roles are only those in the audience list; outside parties (Halden Automation, Tri-Ridge Interstate Pipeline, Lake Haven County 911, Corwin Fire, the NRC, the Pennsylvania PUC, CISA, TSA, the FBI, customers and the media) are played by the SimCell, not seated as players.
